headline: Shivam Autotech intimates exchange about new ISIN for rights entitlement
summary: Shivam Autotech Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the generation of a new ISIN for its rights entitlement. This routine corporate action is part of the company's capital-raising process via a rights issue. Existing shareholders eligible for the rights issue will use this ISIN to trade or apply for the entitlement. Retail investors holding the stock should check their demat accounts for the credit of these rights entitlements.
why_it_matters: Check demat accounts for rights entitlement credits.

headline: Shivam Autotech fixes record date for rights issue
hook: October record date set by Shivam Autotech
summary: Shivam Autotech Limited has announced that October 15, 2026, will serve as the record date for its rights issue. Shareholders holding the company's shares on this date will be eligible for the corporate action. For retail investors holding the stock, this date determines participation eligibility in the upcoming offering.
why_it_matters: Eligibility for the rights issue locked on record date.

headline: Shivam Autotech Announces Outcome of Board Meeting
hook: Routine corporate filing from Shivam Autotech
summary: Shivam Autotech Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 8, 2026. Such procedural filings are routine regulatory requirements for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check the detailed exchange disclosures for any specific corporate actions.
why_it_matters: Check exchange filings for specific corporate announcements.
